change.summary: Major Update 4 removes Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks, Iron's Spells Epic Fight integration, its Epic Fight compatibility adapter, and the now-unused Iron's Library dependency from the managed client and dedicated server.

modifiers.notes: Shared Curios, GeckoLib, Player Animator, Epic Fight, and other independently owned dependencies remain installed. Existing worlds are not regenerated or rewritten.

modifiers.before: 31 Iron/add-on-owned quest cards plus Iron-only rewards on surviving quests
modifiers.after: 31 owned cards removed; surviving quest identities and reward slots retained with installed vanilla replacements

modifiers.before: Optional spell, summon, race, profession, boss-tier, trade, handbook, and quest adapters
modifiers.after: No active JEM runtime adapter or distribution resource targets the removed mod family

cause.owner: Major Update 4 distribution, JEM adapters, questbook, economy, companion recovery, and registry projections

rationale.purpose: Remove Iron's Spells completely without leaving broken quests, missing reward stacks, optional class linkage, generated spawn eggs, economy rows, handbook entries, or recovery policies.
rationale.decision_source: The user explicitly required removal of Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks from the Major Update branch and identified world generation and FTB Quests as required consequence surfaces. Codex selected in-place installed-item reward replacements to preserve surviving quest identities and reward indexes.

introduced.summary: Remove Iron's Spells and its exclusive integration/dependency family for Major Update 4.

history.summary: Deleted the four client/server JARs and configs, removed active integrations, retired 31 owned quests, replaced invalid surviving rewards, and refreshed dependent catalogs.

relations: Iron-owned registry objects become absent from new chunks and unavailable in existing worlds after Forge remaps missing entries
surviving quests keep their native identities and reward ordering
shared dependencies remain because they have non-Iron owners
impacts.notes: No world save, release baseline, stable profile, or MineRENT deployment is part of this change.
